title: Galaxy media placeholder
description: A plain token-coloured surface standing in for a photo, video or artwork until a real one is passed in: a muted fill, or a faint radial wash of the theme's glow for backdrops. It fills whatever box it is given.
notes: size, ratio and radius come from the parent or className
name: galaxy-placeholder

props.name: tone
props.description: muted: a flat raised fill (images, video, art) · glow: a faint wash of the glow colour low in the box (full-bleed backdrops)

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will hold, read to screen readers (e.g. "Portrait video")
